note: Trainer Plaza (APPROVED.md §11). One plaza in the middle of every stage. Hand-written; checked by tests/unit/plaza.test.ts. Effects use the map-event effect kinds (contentSchema EventEffect).

regulars.name: Hollis Grey
regulars.goal: Wants to find the perfect item for every Pokémon in the world.

lines.text: Every Pokémon has an item that suits it. Looking for yours?
Back again! I set this one aside, I thought of your team.
You get it. The right item is a conversation with the Pokémon. Take a look at the good shelf.

regulars.name: Tilda Brightwater
regulars.goal: Is building a ball nobody has ever thrown.

lines.text: Hand-pressed balls, none of that factory rubbish.
Your catches have been getting around. People ask who sells you.
I finally finished my prototype. It rolls like a dream. I will not tell you what it does.

perk.text: Tilda sells you balls at cost.

regulars.name: Mabel Orchard
regulars.goal: Wants one of every berry in a single basket.

lines.text: Fresh picked this morning. Mostly.
The Pokémon always crowd round my cart when you are near.
Do you know a berry can taste of a feeling? Eat this one and tell me what it is.

perk.text: Mabel gives you the bruised ones for less.

regulars.name: Sergeant Brandt
regulars.goal: Wants a trainer worth equipping for a real campaign.

lines.text: Supplies win battles. Pride loses them.
I have seen how you fight. Sensible. I respect sensible.
Take the good kit. Do not thank me. Win.

perk.text: Sergeant Brandt trims 15% off for a fellow campaigner.

regulars.name: Professor Fenwick Lark
regulars.goal: Is trying to document every way a Pokémon can evolve.

lines.text: Stones, scales, strange metals. Everything has a reason.
Your team is an interesting dataset. May I take notes?
I will tell you a secret: some of them evolve because they want to, not because they must.

perk.text: Fenwick charges you the academic rate.

regulars.name: Dottie Vance
regulars.goal: Her shop shelves are full of lovely, pointless, priceless things.

lines.text: Pretty things are never pointless. Ask any Pokémon.
I put the shiny one at the front for you.
Some day I will sell you the one I will not sell anyone.

perk.text: Dottie wraps your purchases and takes 15% off.

regulars.name: Ozzy Prong
regulars.goal: Is cataloguing objects nobody can explain.

lines.text: Do not ask what it is. Ask what it wants.
That thing you carried in? I know what it is. Come closer.
I have never shown anyone the box under the counter. Shall we?

regulars.name: Old Gus
regulars.goal: Has traded a Pokémon with someone in every town and wants to keep going.

lines.text: A fair swap is a good story. A bad swap is a better one.
I told my wife about you. She said I should offer you the good ones.
Only one rule: look after it. That is the whole of the trade.

regulars.name: Vera Quill
regulars.goal: Pins up every notice and is quietly checking which ones are true.

lines.text: Read the notices. Read the signatures. Mostly the signatures.
A few of these are from people who can actually pay. I will point them out.
That one in the corner is mine. Between us, I would like it to be answered.

regulars.name: Nox
regulars.goal: Keeps the alley open and the lights low.

lines.text: I do not know you. You do not know me.
You are in the habit of coming back. That is either bravery or trust.
Come in. The door is for people I would be sorry to lose.

regulars.name: Pip
regulars.goal: Carries messages between every stall and makes a living from it.

lines.text: I run, you do, everyone gets paid. Deal?
They say you are good. Do you do big jobs too?
I put in a good word for you at every stall. You are welcome.

regulars.name: Nurse Elda
regulars.goal: Opened the nurse's tent so nobody leaves the plaza worse than they came.

lines.text: One treatment per customer. The healing stops are there for a reason.
You always take care of them. It shows.
If there is ever an emergency, you are the person I would call.

regulars.name: Coach Imani
regulars.goal: Reads a team the way others read a map.

lines.text: Show me your six. I will tell you what is missing.
I can see you listen to your Pokémon. Most people do not.
If you ever want a sparring partner, ask for the long match.

regulars.name: Lulu Fern
regulars.goal: Believes a brushed coat is a confident Pokémon.

lines.text: A little brushing goes a long way.
Yours are a joy to work on. They like you.
I will put your name on the grooming board. We do that for friends.

stalls.name: Held Goods
stalls.blurb: Held items for every kind of Pokémon.

stalls.name: Field Supplies
stalls.blurb: Boosters, healing and tricks for the next fight.
families: Battle boosters (X items, Dire Hit, Guard Spec.)

stalls.name: Stones & Scales
stalls.blurb: Evolution materials and the odd fossil.

items.hint: Smells like a Pokémon that cannot decide what it is.
The smoke seems to dodge you. Someone else might like that.
Rattles faintly when something dangerous is near.
Frayed at one end. Strong at the other.
Hums when the ground has something to say.
A map, but not of anywhere I have been.
Whoever burns it seems to find coins on the road.
Looks like a monocle. Sees like a lantern.
Plays a note that sleepers do not enjoy.
Warm to the touch, even in the rain.
Sometimes it whispers. Mostly it sulks.
Older than the building. Do not drop it.

traders.name: Spark Trader
traders.line: I will give a lively little mouse for a Normal-type with a good heart.

traders.name: Fenn the Breeder
traders.line: Eevee for a Water-type. Do not ask me why.

traders.name: Nanny Oro
traders.line: A baby Pokémon for a fully evolved one, because I want to raise something new.

traders.name: Rock Collector
traders.line: Heavy trade! 100 kg or more for something that rolls.

traders.name: Mimic Madge
traders.line: Psychic for Psychic: my Mr. Mime for your Abra line.

traders.name: Dragon Dan
traders.line: A dragon egg's worth of trust. A pseudo-dragon's worth of trade. Give me a Fire-type.

traders.name: Parent Pelli
traders.line: A gentle giant for a gentle gift. A Normal-type at level 15 or more.

traders.name: Ferryman Joe
traders.line: Lapras for a Flying-type. She loves company, and so should you.

traders.name: Dr. Digit
traders.line: A Porygon from the lab for an Electric-type. Do not feed it after midnight.

traders.name: The Quiet Man
traders.line: I will trade a legend, but only to someone with a Pokémon that is already one. Level 40 or more.

posts.title: WANTED: A Water-type for a portrait
posts.text: A painter wants a portrait of a Water-type in the plaza fountain. Show one in your party.

posts.title: OFFER: Forge-warm hospitality
posts.text: A smith pays well for a visit from a Fire-type. Show one in your party.

posts.title: WANTED: A Ghost-type for a story night
posts.text: A storyteller wants a spooky guest. Show a Ghost- or Dark-type.

posts.title: WANTED: A heavyweight
posts.text: A removal crew needs a Pokémon of 100 kg or more.

posts.title: WANTED: 1 Star Piece
posts.text: A jeweller needs a Star Piece for a ring.

posts.title: PROOF NEEDED: 6 trainer wins
posts.text: A tournament scout wants to see you have beaten 6 trainers this run.

posts.title: PROOF NEEDED: A badge
posts.text: A guard will let you into the VIP stall with one Gym badge.

posts.title: OFFER: An egg for a favour
posts.text: A farmer will hand over an egg for a fully evolved Pokémon to look at.

posts.title: WANTED: A Pokémon to join a travelling group
posts.text: A young trainer wants to adopt a Pokémon of 40 kg or less that you are willing to part with.

want.label: a Pokémon of 40 kg or less

posts.title: WANTED: 2 Oran Berries
posts.text: A kitchen needs two Oran Berries for the soup.

posts.title: PROOF NEEDED: 10 wild Pokémon beaten
posts.text: A naturalist wants proof you have beaten 10 wild Pokémon this run.

posts.title: WANTED: A Flying-type courier
posts.text: A mail room needs a Flying-type to look at the route.

errands.title: Win three fights for a client
errands.text: A client wants to see you beat 3 trainers on your way out. Prove it, come back.

errands.title: Bring me three Sitrus Berries
errands.text: A wedding needs Sitrus Berries. Any three will do.

errands.title: Test a held item
errands.text: Win two battles with a Pokémon of any kind holding an item and I will take your word for it.

errands.title: Catch something with my ball
errands.text: Catch two wild Pokémon on your way and tell me how the balls handled.

errands.title: Field-test a booster
errands.text: Win four battles and report on the field kit.

errands.title: An evolution for my notes
errands.text: Evolve any Pokémon so I can see it. I will not touch.
errands.rewardText: 5 Research Points and a Dubious Disc

errands.title: Find me a pearl
errands.text: A Pearl or a Big Pearl, for the front window.

errands.title: Dig up a Rare Bone
errands.text: Hand me a Rare Bone. I will not say what it is for.

errands.title: A fair trade, once
errands.text: Make one trade in a Trade Post or an event on your way. I want to hear about it.

errands.title: Win a badge for the board
errands.text: A notice for the Gym leader needs to be delivered. Win a badge and I will count it as delivered.

errands.title: Take a rest at a heal stop
errands.text: Use a healing stop on your road and report that nobody got worse.

errands.title: Show me a Pokémon who loves you
errands.text: A Pokémon at the top of the friendship scale, please. I want to groom it.

errands.title: Beat three before you rest
errands.text: Show me your team can win three fights in a row. Count from now.

errands.title: Keep your mouth shut
errands.text: Nothing to do. Tell nobody about the alley and I will tell you what it holds. Return with a clean record: no evil.

club.name: Friendly Match
club.text: One casual match against a visiting trainer. A loss only costs you pride.

club.name: Short Streak
club.text: Three matches back to back. Your team is not healed in between.
club.prizeText: ₽400 each round, then 2 Hyper Potions and +1 Strength

club.name: Themed Cup
club.text: Today's cup is limited to one type of foe, chosen by the board. A good place to test a counter.
club.prizeText: ₽500 each round, then a held item and 3 Research Points

club.name: Challenge Team
club.text: A veteran with a gym leader's signature team. The prize is serious.
club.prizeText: 2 Rare Candies, a held item and +1 Charisma

alley.entry: Someone has to vouch for you, or you have to look like a person who wouldn't mind.

offers.title: Stolen shipment
offers.text: A crate off a truck. Maybe good gear, maybe a Mimic. Cheap.
offers.troubleText: The crate was tagged. Somebody took something back.

offers.title: A forbidden egg
offers.text: Don't ask where it came from. Hatches into something strong.
offers.troubleText: The seller's guard dogs have opinions about this.

offers.title: A suspicious contract
offers.text: Take ₽3000 now. Pay it back double when the stage ends. The fine print is tiny.
offers.troubleText: The debt collectors are quick today.

offers.title: A ball with no stamp
offers.text: A Master Ball, or something shaped like one.
offers.troubleText: It was a fake. A very loud fake.

offers.title: A no-questions Pokémon
offers.text: A shiny-looking Pokémon with no owner. It really, really wants to be yours.
offers.troubleText: Your Pokémon don't like what they just saw.

offers.title: Fence your finds
offers.text: Sell off a Valuable at a premium and no receipt. Nox pays well for a Star Piece.

services.name: Nurse's Tent
services.text: Full HP, no status, full PP. One treatment per plaza.

services.name: Grooming Stall
services.text: A brush, a bath, a bow. Your party gains friendship.

services.name: Appraisal Desk
services.text: Have a held-item cache valued: the first valuable you hand over sells for double.

services.name: Team Advice
services.text: Coach Imani reads your party against the gym leader on this stage.

events.name: A Quiet Day
events.text: Nothing special: just a good, busy day in the plaza.

events.name: Harvest Festival
events.text: Bunting is up. Stalls take 15% off and Mabel is giving away berries.
events.giftText: A free basket of Oran Berries

events.name: Open Tournament
events.text: The Battle Club is packed. Fees are half price and prizes pay double money.

events.name: Plaza Auction
events.text: An auctioneer is selling off a hall of oddities. Stalls charge a little more but sell better stock.

events.name: Emergency
events.text: A crowd crush! Everybody helps. Services are free today and everyone notices who stepped up.

events.name: Visiting Celebrity
events.text: A famous trainer is shaking hands. Everyone is on their best behaviour.

events.name: Evacuation
events.text: Sirens! Stalls have shut and everyone is leaving in orderly lines. Relief workers hand out supplies.
events.giftText: A relief pack: a Max Potion and ₽400

caravans.name: The Ringmaster's Caravan
caravans.text: A travelling circus of Pokémon performers. They stay for one visit.

offers.title: Watch the show
offers.text: A joyful hour. Your whole party gains friendship.

offers.title: Buy the juggling balls
offers.text: Six Poké Balls, slightly sticky.

caravans.name: Scholars' Wagon
caravans.text: A wagon of researchers with a wall of notes.

offers.title: Attend a lecture
offers.text: +1 Intelligence and 4 Research Points.

offers.title: Commission a field scan
offers.text: Reveals every hidden "?" stop on this stage.

caravans.name: Fortune Teller's Cart
caravans.text: A purple cart with a lamp on a hook.

offers.title: Have your fortune read
offers.text: A reading. +1 Luck.

offers.title: Buy a charm
offers.text: A Luck Incense, guaranteed or your money back.

caravans.name: Merchants' Exchange
caravans.text: Traders from three regions with a list of swaps.

offers.title: Swap 4 berries for a stone
offers.text: Hand over four Oran Berries for a random evolution stone.

offers.title: Premium crate
offers.text: A rare held item, no questions.

factions.name: Silph Co.
factions.text: A booth with free pens and a demo of the new scope.

offers.title: Try the demo
offers.text: A free sample: 3 Research Points.

offers.title: Buy a Silph Scope
offers.text: Sees hidden stops. Pricey.

factions.name: Team Rocket
factions.text: A man in a black cap and an even blacker smile.

offers.title: Hear the pitch
offers.text: A bag of cash for a small favour. +₽1500, -1 Good.

offers.title: Buy the 'bargain' crate
offers.text: A held item with questionable origin.

factions.name: Pokémon Rangers
factions.text: A friendly ranger at a booth full of leaflets and a very sleepy Pachirisu.

offers.title: Volunteer a day
offers.text: Help clean the plaza. +1 Good and a free Full Heal.

offers.title: Buy ranger gear
offers.text: A Repel pack and a Town Map.

factions.name: League Scouts
factions.text: A neat lanyard and a neat clipboard.

offers.title: Sign the register
offers.text: Register your run. +1 Charisma.

offers.title: Buy the contender's kit
offers.text: A training bundle for the long road.

rumors.text: A roaming legend was seen near the coast. Fishers say the sea went quiet.
Somebody found feathers in the plaza fountain. Three different colours.
Men in black are buying every Repel in the district.
A hideout was sighted near the old rail yard, but nobody has been back since.
A Pokémon with an odd colour was spotted in the tall grass by the north gate.
They say the swarm patch east of here has doubled this week.
A trainer with no Pokémon but a big bag has been hanging round the shops.
That quiet kid by the bench has beaten every trainer in town. Twice.
The gym leader has changed their lineup three times this month.
Rumour has it the gym leader only eats berries the morning of a battle.
Folk who take the left fork after the plaza say the road bends somewhere it shouldn't.
A traveller left a bag by the path and never came back for it.
Pearls have been washing up under the bridge. Locals keep it quiet.
Your rival was seen buying potions, and laughing a little too loud.

reactions.text: Your Grass-type nuzzles Mabel's basket and will not let go.
Your Water-type spins in the fountain and sprays Tilda's shelf.
Your Fire-type takes up a position beside Sergeant Brandt, who nods in approval.
Your Electric-type and Pip race round the plaza twice. It wins.
Your Ghost-type floats into Ozzy's stall and refuses to leave. Ozzy looks delighted and a bit nervous.
Your Dark-type sniffs the way to the alley and stares at the back wall.
Your Normal-type sits on Gus's feet. He doesn't mind.
Your Psychic-type stares at Professor Fenwick, who stares back. Neither blinks.
Your Fairy-type is thrilled by Dottie's shelves and picks out a ribbon for you.
Your Fighting-type squares up to Coach Imani for a handshake. Her grip wins.
Your Dark-type growls at the Rocket recruiter's booth.
Your Pokémon recognise your rival's footsteps before you do.
Your Pokémon give an old opponent a long look: not a glare, not quite a greeting.

early: Everyone is still sizing each other up. The plaza has the buzz of a first day.
Banners are going up; there is a big week ahead and nobody knows what comes first.
preBoss: The gym leader's name is on every lip. People are gossiping about their ace.
Trainers are practising in corners, nervous about what's ahead.
Even the stalls have gone a bit quiet: something big is coming.
postBadge: People pat your back and ask about the gym. Your badge is the talk of the plaza.
Somebody is telling the story of your last battle, and getting it mostly right.
late: The plaza is full of rare faces: these are the people who made it this far.
An old trainer nods at you and says nothing, which is the highest praise.
